correctness.rationale: Kleiman's conormal/Segre formula gives deg(X^vee)=D h_n(d_i-1) for a smooth nonlinear complete intersection. Modulo two, h_n reduces to the coefficient of (1-t)^(-e), where e is the number of even defining degrees, hence to binom(n+e-1,n); Kummer--Lucas gives the no-carry criterion n&(e-1)=0. If all degrees are odd, homogeneity factors out 2^n and the same argument applies to the number of degrees congruent to 3 mod 4. The stated mod-4 consequences follow exactly.

value.rationale: Projective-dual degree is a canonical enumerative invariant. The theorem gives a dimension- and codimension-uniform arithmetic structure theorem, extends the classical odd-dimensional evenness to every positive-dimensional complete intersection, and sharply identifies the mod-4 boundary. The bitwise criterion also separates when the defining-degree 2-adic contribution is the entire valuation from when extra cancellation is forced.
